deploy_models_on_cluster: run deploy_models to start a cluster and deploy multiple models with SLURM workers
deploy_models_reuse_cluster: run deploy_models to reuse an existing cluster and deploy new models with REPLACE action
deploy_models_add_strategy: run deploy_models with ADD action when sufficient CPU and GPU resources are available
deploy_models_check_status: run deploy_models to check existing application status and skip deployment if all models are RUNNING
deploy_models_remove_failed: run deploy_models to remove failed apps with zero replicas before redeploying
